result.summary: The page is generally coherent and usable, but a few carousel and fixed-navigation elements look visually clipped or unfinished at the screen edges.

issues.description: A category pill is partially visible on the far right with no readable label, which makes it look like an empty or broken chip.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal category carousel spacing/snap behavior so partially visible chips still show enough label text, or add right padding so the clipped chip does not appear empty.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off at the right edge, including the restaurant name and delivery text.
issues.suggestion: Use carousel snapping or slightly reduce card width/gaps so partially visible cards look intentional and text is not awkwardly clipped.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation area, making the content feel abruptly cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content so cards can scroll fully above the bottom navigation.
